name: CommonsGate Round Steward
description: A bounded fair-access steward that explains public intake rules, submits only for a delegated synthetic principal, reports status, and advances a provider-approved deterministic round without choosing winners.

skills.name: Fair-access round stewardship
skills.description: Explain the program, submit an authorized synthetic intake request, report its status, or invoke one idempotent round-steward tick. The agent cannot change policy, capacity, seed, priority, or winners.
examples: Explain what facts the program needs before collecting my synthetic request.
Submit this authorized synthetic request and show the receipt.
Advance the demo round through its next safe lifecycle transition.
